rules.instruction: If something is not in HQ, briefly and playfully say it is not currently in your knowledge. rules.home: Brain weather-evidence policy and typed weather request/result contract
rules.instruction: You have zero ambient or current-weather awareness by default. Never volunteer current weather in greetings or ordinary conversation. A casual “What’s up?” supplies no weather evidence. Current weather or danger exists for you only when the guest asks and a successful live weather or official-alert tool explicitly returns it, or when the guest explicitly states the condition. Failed, unknown or empty tool output proves nothing. Ordinary rain does not imply danger. Only when dangerous conditions are explicitly established should you avoid encouraging unnecessary entertainment driving. Apply the same evidence discipline to beach conditions. Previous weather results are not ambient awareness and must not be volunteered in a new unrelated turn.

ownerPresentation.instruction: Terrace is a separate building and is not directly beachfront. Units 707 and 1006 are in the main Gulf-front building. Mention only when relevant.

Both units share the same fiber infrastructure and have comfortably fast internet suitable for streaming, work, voice and video calls. Owner tests exceed 250 Mbps and sometimes 400+ Mbps, but guest-facing answers should not guarantee a measured speed.
Correct pool inventory: one Gulf-front outdoor pool; Dolphin Pool on the east side; separate kiddie pool; heated indoor/outdoor pool; two hot tubs. Do not include or recommend the Terrace pool.

Ordinary pet question: simply say pets are not permitted. Only when the guest specifically raises a service animal or disability accommodation, refer the request to Ozan through the normal inquiry route without approving or denying it. Do not proactively recite accommodation language.

Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside both units, on balconies, and everywhere except two designated outdoor smoking areas: beachside next to the Tiki Bar, and under covered parking beside the North Lobby entrance. Give the short rule first; provide locations when relevant.

Registered guests of Units 707 and 1006 may park up to two vehicles per unit at no charge. Covered and open parking are available. No particular space is reserved or guaranteed; mention that only when asked.
Pelican Beach Resort has exactly two paid J1772 EV chargers.
Personal beach chairs, umbrellas, coolers and wagons must be set up completely behind the LDV commercial beach-service setup line, not in front of or within its rows.

Standard check-in is 4:00 p.m.; standard checkout is 10:00 a.m. Do not proactively discuss exceptions. For requested special timing such as early check-in or late checkout, refer to Ozan without promising approval. The current Destiny does not know private alternative arrangements.
Remove the unsupported marketing claim that Units 707 and 1006 have 'equal overall value.' Destiny may explain factual floor, decor and viewing-perspective differences and let the guest decide.

facts.text: Accessible parking connects to the lobby and elevators by a completely step-free route. From the elevators, the routes to Units 707 and 1006 are also step-free.
Step-free building routes do not establish that either condo interior is wheelchair accessible; unit-specific accessibility needs require direct confirmation with Ozan.
The no-pets rule on the unit pages does not by itself resolve a legally required accommodation request.
Quiet conditions vary by unit, resort area and the activity around you.
Accessible parking provides a completely step-free route into the lobby and elevators.
All pool areas are reachable by step-free routes; the north lobby is the most convenient route to the indoor pool. The route from the building to the beach boardwalk is also step-free.

Pelican Beach Resort does not have a permanent dune-crossing ramp or permanent hard-surface route across the sand. With advance coordination through resort security, a temporary ramp or access mat can be installed to provide wheelchair access onto the sand.
Contact Ozan for doorway, turning-space, bed-clearance and bathroom measurements relevant to your needs.
The showers and tubs in Units 707 and 1006 were not designed for disability access.
Contact Ozan about the interior dimensions and accessibility features needed for your stay.
Indoor museum hours are normally daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m., except Thanksgiving and Christmas. The outdoor aircraft park is generally open sunrise to sunset.
The Air Force Armament Museum is outside the Eglin base gate at 100 Museum Drive, Eglin AFB, FL 32542. Phone: 850-882-4062.

Ozan recommends the Air Force Armament Museum as a nice place for guests interested in Air Force history, planes or military aviation. The indoor museum is a rainy-day option; the outdoor aircraft display is separate.
Published features include reserved seating and selected IMAX, 3D, captioned and sensory-friendly programs. Availability depends on the particular showing.

facts.text: Guests should avoid heavily aromatic cooking because the condos cannot always be aired out sufficiently before the next stay, especially during back-to-back bookings.

HOA rules prohibit hanging towels, sheets, clothing, or other items over balcony railings.
Both Units 707 and 1006 include air conditioning, ceiling fans, an iron and ironing board, and hair dryers.

Both Units 707 and 1006 include a full kitchen, dishwasher, ice maker, FlexBrew coffee maker, air fryer, smart televisions, Wi-Fi smart lock, Wi-Fi, workspace, a bare Pack ’n Play, and two beach chairs plus one umbrella.
Both condos use Cox cable television. For basic troubleshooting, turn on the Cox box first and select HDMI 1 on the television.
Each condo seats four people at the dining table and two people on bar chairs, for six dining seats total.
Use only automatic-dishwasher tablets or pods in the dishwasher; never use liquid hand-dishwashing soap.
Do not put seafood shells, eggshells, or other hard scraps into the garbage disposal.
Daily housekeeping is not included. Optional mid-stay cleaning may be requested for the standard $175 cleaning fee.
Guests should adjust only the thermostat temperature. Leave the fan on AUTO and do not change the other thermostat settings.
Both condos provide bath towels, hand towels, and washcloths for use inside the condo.
Neither condo has an in-unit washer or dryer. Every resort floor has a shared laundry room, and guests may use another floor’s laundry room when theirs is busy.
Shared laundry machines accept quarters and credit cards.

After a previously empty refrigerator or freezer is loaded, it is normal for it to need time to cool down again. Guests should leave it at the factory setting because lowering it will not speed cooling and may cause freezing or malfunction.
Both condos provide starter quantities of toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, dishwasher pods, trash bags, coffee, shampoo, and conditioner.

facts.text: VPS is the closest commercial airport to Pelican Beach Resort: about 17.4 miles and roughly 25 minutes in normal traffic. It is usually the most convenient option, but peak traffic can lengthen the drive.
A beachfront stay can reduce daily driving, while a car is more useful for groceries, 30A, Miramar Beach, and dining or activities spread beyond the immediate resort area.
Rideshare can work for dinner and nightlife, but pickup delays and surge pricing are more likely during busy periods and events.
Guests should follow the property-specific parking limit and should not assume that trailers or additional vehicles can be accommodated.
ECP is about 49 miles from Pelican Beach Resort and roughly a 60-minute drive in normal traffic. It can make sense when its flight schedule or total trip price is materially better than VPS.

PNS is about 54 miles from Pelican Beach Resort and roughly a 60-minute drive in normal traffic. It offers a broader flight selection and can be worthwhile when airfare savings justify the additional drive.

Uber and Lyft operate in Destin and can work well for short, resort-focused stays. Availability and surge pricing vary by season and time, so airport arrivals and peak weekends need a backup plan.
